lines.en: label mikuspring4:
scene sky
I tap on Miku’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
And, guess what? I’m going to do something kind today.
Now, you may be asking why I’m going to do something kind. And to that, I say-
I have no idea.
I just know that Miku’s never really done anything wrong, so she deserves to be rewarded for being an entirely neutral force in my life who also lets me touch her inappropriately at times.
: Hiya, Sensei! Good morning!
But just how will I reward her, you ask?
: What’s up? Want to come over and put your wiener in my mouth?
With some good old-fashioned physical activity.
: I was actually wondering if you wanted to go for a jog or something.
Just not the kind you were expecting.
I’m just full of surprises, aren’t I?
: Hm? What was that? Any chance ya can speak up, Sensei? Think I might be hearin’ things again.
: I said I was wondering if you- wait, what do you mean “again?”
: Oh, you know. Just that never-ending screaming people get in their heads. Sounds kinda like a demon crossed with some kinda tiger or somethin’.
: ...What?
: Yeah, you know how it is.
: I...don’t. But again, I was wondering if you wanted to go for a jog. Maybe we could meet up in the park?
: Miku?
: Who the heck are you and what have ya done with Sensei?! Cause I ain’t got any money for his ransom, but there are these two rich girls I know who’ll flat out buy the dude if ya let ‘em!
: Are you really that shocked by this? We used to run together all the time, didn’t we?
: “All the time” is a little generous, don’t ya think? We only did that a couple times and it seemed like you hated every friggin’ minute of it.
: Not every minute. Just the ones when we were running.
: Exactly! So why bother doin’ somethin’ if it’s just gonna make ya-
: To make you happy.
: Ah...huh?
: It’s fine to do things for you every once in a while. And it’s not like jogging will hurt me. At least...not long term.
: Plus, I could probably use the workout since I’m still recovering from those two months in bed.
: Ya mean that sleepover bangathon you had with my roommate the other day wasn’t enough of a workout for you?
: It’s good to see you two are still sharing every detail about your sex lives with each other.
: Makoto just likes braggin’. Any time I try to say anythin’, she just gets mad at me.
: But Sensei...you really sure about this? Cause I’m fine just...comin’ over to your place and stuff. We ain’t gotta make it about me.
: Then just think of it as you helping me get back into shape.
: There are other-
: Non-sexually.
: You bored of my little boy physique now? I ain’t enough woman for ya? That what’s goin’ on here?
: Miku, are we doing this or not?
: HECK YEAH WE’RE DOIN’ IT, ARE YOU KIDDING?! I ain’t been this excited to hang out since I learned what an orgasm feels like!
: I’m just...a little surprised. That’s all.
: But...I’ll get dressed right now! Meet me at the park in five minutes!
: That’s...way too soon.
: Then ten minutes! Bye, Sensei!
Miku hangs up the phone and I need to quickly throw on whatever clothes I can find that are suitable for running.
scene mikuparkjog1
But, as it turns out, I don’t have any clothes that are suitable for running so I just wind up sticking with my normal outfit.
Maybe I should go shopping soon?

: Hey! I got here early and couldn’t sit still, so I’ve already done a few laps around the place. That’s okay, right? I can still keep going! Don’t worry! Or do if it means you care about me! Anyway, hi!
It’s been significantly longer than ten minutes, but placing such an unrealistic expectation on me when she lives closer to this place than I do makes my tardiness her fault, not mine.
: Hey. Sorry for keeping you waiting, Miku.
I apologize regardless of none of this being my fault because I have grown as a person and can do that now.
This growth will also be demonstrated several minutes from now when she makes me look like an old man by running circles around me as people look on in secondhand embarrassment.
Actually, on second thought, maybe we should just go exercise in my usual way?
scene mikuparkjog2
: The heck are you apologizin’ for? I just told ya I got here early, didn’t I?
: I was just...excited. That’s all. This is...really cool of you, Sensei. Nobody ever wants to go running with me anymore. Like, even Karin’s been weird about it lately.
: Yeah, well...I’m sure she has her reasons.
scene mikuparkjog3
: So, like...um...do you just want to get started? Or...maybe take a break first since you just walked all the way here.
: You gonna put me to shame this time or are you willing to once again try and match my pace?
scene mikuparkjog4
: You ain’t gotta worry about me takin’ off on ya, Sensei! I ain’t gonna mess up this once in a lifetime opportunity!
: Is it really “once in a lifetime” if it’s already happened multiple times?
: That was with the old Sensei who was still trying to figure out how to get into my pants! New Sensei doesn’t have to try anymore, so things like this might never happen again for all I know!
: That...is both annoyingly perceptive and depressingly accurate.
scene mikuparkjog5

: You ain’t the only one who’s gone from one side’a the room to the other, Sensei. I, too, have seen the light. And I now understand just how silly I was to keep my pants on in the first place. Puberty, am I right?
: Sadly, yes.
scene mikuparkjog4
: Great! So let’s get this show on the road, then!
scene sky
: On your mark!
: Get set-
: Go!
: Ah- Sensei?! You seriously tryin’ to get a head start on me?!
scene mikuparkjog6
: The heck you think you’re doin’? Ain’t we supposed to be keepin’ up with each other? Or is this just how ya tell me you’ve been secretly trainin’ this whole time and are now ready to defeat me?!
: Just for a second, I wanted everyone else around to think I’m faster than you. It’s something I’ve never experienced before.
: What kinda grown man has “being faster than a teenage girl” on his friggin’ bucket list?
: The kind who’s knocked off pretty much everything else already except “learn how to smile.”
scene mikuparkjog7
: Ya’d think with all those billboards around tellin’ us to remember to do that, you’d have figured it out by now.
: Why do you think those are there in the first place? They’re very...1984, aren’t they?
: Damn, they’ve been there for that long?
: ...Yup. That’s what I meant.
: Ain’t you only 30, though? How the heck do you remember stuff from...uhh...more than 30 years ago...I think.
: It’s a book, Miku. I’m talking about a book.
scene mikuparkjog8
: Then I am no longer interested!
: Also, I’m 31.
: That ain’t no excuse for a lack’a speed, grandpa! Amp it up, would ya?! We’re gonna do a hundred laps today!
I am never being kind again.
scene sky
As much as I’d like to brag about how I lasted the full one hundred laps, I began to struggle after just five.
Well, technically, I began to struggle after just one. But I didn’t reveal that I was actually struggling to Miku until the sixth lap since I wanted her to think I was cool.
So while my kindness lived fast and died young, it was not wasted. It adopted the same unspoken motto Miku has to make every second worth it because you never know when those seconds will run out.

I do hope this isn’t me somehow foreshadowing that she’s going to actually die young, though. If Makoto loses anyone else, I think she’ll probably just lock herself in her room for the rest of her life.
But hey, if the afterlife is real, maybe Miku would get to see her parents again. I just hope they’re all in one piece.
scene mikuparkjog9
Anyway, here’s me being rewarded with a lap pillow just seconds after monologuing about my pillow’s dead parents.
The bounties of this fast-paced life never seem to end.
: You did great today, Sensei. And I can’t even be mad that you’ve got the stamina of an old dog cause you’ve got the heart of one too.
: It means a lot that you were willin’ to do this for me, ya know. It felt great too. In a different way than all those times you get sexy with me.
scene mikuparkjog10
: Kinda funny, though. Been so excited by how that stuff feels lately that I almost forgot what things were like before I started learnin’ all that.
: Things are a little crazy now, ain’t they? What with you bein’ pulled every which way by every single girl ya know. But that’s just...that’s why it makes today even more special.
scene mikuparkjog11
: You could’a been with any one of them...doin’ anything you want...and yet you chose to do somethin’ you hate with me.
: Is this what havin’ a boyfriend’s like?
scene mikuparkjog12
: W-Which isn’t me sayin’ I think you’re my boyfriend! I get we’re just really good friends or...whatever we are! It just kinda feels like-
scene mikuparkjog13
: Wait, are you even awake?
scene mikuparkjog14
: I like you so much, Sensei.
: I’m awake, Miku.
scene mikuparkjog15
: Gyah!
: Gyah.
: The heck were you stayin’ so quiet for?! How long were you gonna let me ramble on about all that embarrassin’ stuff?!
: Why be embarrassed at all? I like you too.
scene mikuparkjog16
: Yeah, but...not in the girlfriend way, right? Ain’t we just, like...friends with benefits or whatever it’s called? That’s what the Internet said.

: But the Internet also told me the earth is flat and I’m pretty sure that ain’t true since globes are all circular and stuff. Why would all those astronauts just lie to us by makin’ fake globes like that?
: Miku, you’re okay with me seeing multiple people, aren’t you?
scene mikuparkjog17
: Huh? Yeah. That doesn’t really bother me.
: So then, just out of curiosity, what would be the difference to you if I actually was your boyfriend? Because for most people, that’s sort of an exclusivity deal.
: Exclusivity?
: Most real couples are just that — couples. But if that’s not how it is for you, I’m not really sure what the difference would be between what we are now and how we would be as an official pair.
scene mikuparkjog18
: I wanna say it’d be the part where I can talk to other people about it. But Makoto says sometimes that stuff stays secret even when people are together, so...
: I don’t...really know?
scene mikuparkjog19
: Maybe it’s like a...promise or somethin’? A way to know ya ain’t just gonna get bored of me and go chase somebody with huge bazongas one day.
: That’s not the case either, though. Real relationships also end without warning sometimes. That’s kind of just how it works.
: I ain’t really got an answer for ya, Sensei. Ain’t somethin’ I ever thought much about until recently.
scene mikuparkjog20
: There’s just somethin’ that sounds really nice about makin’ somethin’ like what we’ve got official, ya know? I’d feel a lot more...important.
scene mikuparkjog21
: I wish everyone looked at it that way. Because I’ve been letting Chika call me her boyfriend for years now and, due to recent events, I’m now worried she’s going to start killing all of you.
: Jesus, Sensei. First Ami, now Chika? I like ya a lot, don’t get me wrong, but they must really like you if they’re thinkin’ about goin’ that far.

: I’m actually more worried about Chika than Ami if you want my honest opinion. Because I think my outlook is more like yours and, when I tried explaining that to her the other day, she...kind of snapped?
: Whaddya mean “snapped?”
: Talking to herself. Staring off into space. Saying she understands things that she definitely does not.
: Pretty sure that’s Yasu you’re talkin’ about, Sensei. She’s the one with white hair. You really been away from school for so long that ya can’t even remember who’s who anymore?
: This was different from the way Yasu does those things, Miku.
scene mikuparkjog17

: All I’m saying is that I wish more girls were like you. For entirely selfish purposes, of course. Not because I think the world would be better that way as I would certainly not be willing to share you.
: So if I wanted to hook up with some other guy, that’d be a total no-go?
: Right.
: How come?
: Come on, Sensei. You asked me to tell ya what I meant. Least ya can do is return the favor.
scene mikuparkjog22
: Jealousy.
: Makoto says the same thing. Something about not lettin’ other people play with your belongings and stuff?
: Am I on the right track?
: I used to have feelings for someone who belonged to someone else.
scene mikuparkjog23
: More than just feelings, actually. But...I’ve probably always been a jealous person.
: When I want someone, I want them to be mine and mine alone. And I don’t want to share them because I don’t want anyone else to ruin them.
: But...
: More than that, I think I’m worried that the person I’d be sharing would see how small I am compared to everyone else.
scene mikuparkjog24
: That’s a small one?! How friggin’ big do they get?!
: As a person, Miku. I’m not talking about my penis.
scene mikuparkjog25
: Do you really not feel that way? Because you’ve joked about it — but what if I really did just...move on from you one day because you didn’t have something I wanted when someone else did?
scene mikuparkjog26
: Why...are you smiling now? That was a pretty heavy question.
: Cause I get it when ya put it like that.
: I would be sad if ya left me in the dust.
: I can’t give ya brains like Makoto or boobs like Futaba. I ain’t as creative as Nodoka, ain’t as stylish as Chika, and I ain’t even half as cute as Ami.
: I ain’t got much, really. Don’t even have a family anymore. All I have to give is myself. So yeah...I get it now. But I don’t look at it the same way you do.
: It’s because of what I lack that I understand why you’d wanna get all that stuff elsewhere. Ain’t wrong to want more out of life...more out of a partner...and I want ya to be happy.
: Chase after whatever it is ya want, Sensei. I ain’t goin’ anywhere.
: And I know it ain’t sayin’ much since there’re barely any guys left in Kumon-mi to begin with, but you’re the only one I need right now anyway.
: ...What? Why’re you just lookin’ at me like that?
: You’ve really grown up, Miku.
: Not without help, I haven’t.
: You’ve done so much for me, Sensei. Ya helped me figure out who I am and that’s...that’s a thing I ain’t ever been able to do on my own.
: There are other ways you can still help me, though...I’ve got a lot left to learn.
: Of course. Whatever it is, just let me know.
: I was actually just thinking earlier about how unproblematic you’ve been so far. So if I can return the favor in any way-
: Sensei.
: ...Miku?
: I’ve got a lot left to learn.
: Are you pickin’ up what I’m puttin’ down right now?
scene mikuparkjog27
: I wanna do it with you...
scene mikuparkjog28
: ...Seriously?
: Seriously.
: You made me really happy today...and now I wanna make you happy too.
: Makoto says I’m supposed to wear a condom, though.
scene black
: But I don’t wanna.
$ mikuspring4 = True
